title.zh: 将南阿古桑省Bayugan的Salvacion描笼涯中学改设为国立政府资助的中学，名称为Salvacion国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Barangay High School At Barangay Salvacion. Bayugan, Agusan Del Sur, Into a National Government-Funded Secondary School to Be Known as the Salvacion National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Barangay High School At Barangay Salvacion. Bayugan, Agusan Del Sur, Into a National Government-Funded Secondary School to Be Known as the Salvacion National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8667_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The high school owned and administered by the Parents-Teachers Association at Barangay Salvacion, Municipality of Bayugan, Province of Agusan Del Sur, is hereby absorbed by the national government and converted into a regular secondary school, under the full control and supervision of the national government through the Department of Education, Culture and Sports to be known as the Salvacion National High School.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the barangay high school are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Salvacion National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
